why is 'weather forecasts include lead plume' trending?? is that a joke
grounding: Real, not a joke. The US Army plans to detonate about 9,500 pounds (WIRED) of degraded lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa; a local TV weather report (KCRG link shared by @gammacounter.bsky.social) included a lead plume forecast, which set off the trend. Timeline from posts: The Intercept (11-19) on the Army's 'just rinse it off' guidance; a court put a hold on the permit (Iowa Public Radio, 11-20); Gov. Kim Reynolds activated the state emergency operations center; BBC (11-22) said the Army would go ahead despite the court order; Task & Purpose (11-23) says it is rescheduled for Wednesday. Posts note the Army cancelled a chemical-neutralisation contract with Munirem and that Illinois and Missouri are within range; a circulated map says the shaded area is distance, not a projected exposure zone.
